method: Read each exact NAS-backed HWP5 OLE BodyText/Section0, apply raw deflate, parse each 4-byte little-endian record header as tag ID 10 bits, level 10 bits and size 12 bits (extended 4-byte size when 0xFFF); decode only tag 67 HWPTAG_PARA_TEXT payloads as UTF-16LE. Preserve paragraph record order/level and control tokens; do not derive numeric amounts from other years.
control_gate: Before interpreting 2018-2020, the same record parser must recover 2021 export semiconductor 6,394/+23.9 and 2022 5,573/-12.8 as adjacent table-cell paragraphs after the semiconductor label. If either fails, stop with concrete parser evidence.
unknown_year_gate: For each 2018-2020 HWP, report every semiconductor paragraph and neighboring numeric paragraph with record order/level. Accept one export amount and YoY only if the export table heading, matching period/unit and row sequence distinguish it from imports, total exports and annual cumulative figures. Ambiguity stays unknown; do not use secondary transcriptions or outcome signs to choose.
stop: One parser repair only. Retain previous raw-token probe, source bytes and original plans. Historical first-public attachment bytes and full monthly training coverage remain unqualified.
